top_signals.title: Houthis Claim Ballistic Missile Hit on Saudi Oil Tanker in Red Sea
top_signals.summary: The Iran-aligned Houthi group in Yemen on Wednesday claimed a “precise hit” on a Saudi oil tanker in the Red Sea, Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said. “The Yemeni Armed Forces conducted a military operation targeting the Saudi oil tanker 'Wafaa' north of the Red Sea off the Yambu area using several ballistic missiles,” according to the Houthi statement carried by Middle East news outlet Al Bawaba.
